name: War-Awoken Searing Prominence (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒焦熱のプロミネンス
effects:
One single piercing ranged attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire Abilities to user, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if the user has at least Lv. 0/2 Attach Fire
WS Blue: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, Fire Ability Damage +40% & Instant Fire to user
